# Psychology Today Canada

> Psychology Today Canada provides mental health articles, expert commentary, and a directory for finding therapists, treatment centres, and support groups.

The site combines editorial coverage of psychology, relationships, behavior, and wellbeing with searchable professional listings across Canada. It also offers condition overviews, topic hubs, and resources for mental health professionals seeking visibility.

## Core Pages
- [Psychology Today Canada](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca): Canadian homepage for psychology news, mental health guidance, and provider search.
- [News](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/news): Latest psychology and mental health news, research coverage, and expert analysis.
- [Today’s Essential Reads](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca): Featured articles on relationships, behavior, purpose, and mental health.
- [Find a Therapist](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists): Search Canadian therapists, psychologists, and counsellors by location and specialty.
- [Login](https://member.psychologytoday.com/ca/login): Member login for professionals managing listings and account settings.
- [Sign Up & Get Listed](https://join.psychologytoday.com/ca/signup): Registration page for professionals who want to join the directory.

## Find Help
- [Find a Therapist](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists): Main therapist directory with location-based browsing across Canada.
- [Treatment Centres](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/treatment-rehab): Directory of treatment and rehab centres by location and service type.
- [Support Groups](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/groups): Directory of support groups and group therapy options.
- [Therapists in Canada](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists): Browse therapists, psychologists, and counsellors across provinces and cities.
- [Treatment Centres in Canada](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/treatment-rehab): Browse inpatient, outpatient, and rehab providers in Canada.
- [Support Groups in Canada](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/groups): Browse support groups for mental health, addiction, and life challenges.

- [Montréal, QC Therapists](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists/qc/montreal): Therapist directory for Montréal with specialty and insurance filters.
- [Ottawa, ON Therapists](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists/on/ottawa): Ottawa-area therapists, psychologists, and counsellors.
- [Toronto, ON Therapists](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists/on/toronto): Large therapist directory for Toronto and surrounding areas.
- [Vancouver, BC Therapists](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists/bc/vancouver): Vancouver therapist listings with issue and approach filters.
- [Winnipeg, MB Therapists](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists/mb/winnipeg): Therapist directory for Winnipeg mental health providers.

## Editorial and News
- [News](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/news): Central hub for current psychology and mental health reporting.
- [The Latest](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/news): Recent articles and updates from Psychology Today editors and contributors.
- [Health, Help, Happiness](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca): Homepage editorial coverage spanning wellbeing, relationships, and behavior.
- [See More News](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/news): Expanded access to recent news and feature stories.
- [Psychology Today Canada Homepage](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca): Entry point to featured reads, news, and directories.

## Mental Health Topics
- [Mental Health](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics): Topic hub for psychological conditions, traits, and treatment concepts.
- [Relationships](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/topics/relationships): Articles and expert guidance on romantic and interpersonal relationships.
- [Addiction](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/addiction): Overview articles on addiction, behavior, and recovery.
- [ADHD](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/adhd): Reference content on ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.
- [Autism](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/autism): Introductory and practical content about autism spectrum conditions.
- [Anxiety](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/anxiety): Articles on anxiety symptoms, causes, and coping strategies.
- [Depression](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/depression): Reference content on depression and evidence-based support.
- [Therapy](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/therapy): Explanations of therapy types, goals, and what to expect.

## Basics Library
- [Basics](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics): Main reference library for psychology and mental health topics.
- [Stress](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/stress): Topic overview covering stress responses and management.
- [Trauma](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/trauma): Reference articles on trauma, effects, and recovery.
- [Personality](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/personality): Explanations of personality traits and individual differences.
- [Sleep](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/sleep): Articles on sleep health, habits, and mental wellbeing.
- [Self-Esteem](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/self-esteem): Guidance on confidence, self-worth, and emotional resilience.
- [Mindfulness](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/mindfulness): Introductory content on mindfulness practices and benefits.
- [Psychotherapy](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/basics/psychotherapy): Overview of psychotherapy approaches and use cases.

## For Professionals
- [Professionals](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists): Public-facing professional directory for therapists and counsellors.
- [Sign Up & Get Listed](https://join.psychologytoday.com/ca/signup): Join page for therapists and mental health professionals.
- [Member Login](https://member.psychologytoday.com/ca/login): Access listing management and member tools.
- [Therapist Directory](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/therapists): Public profile listings for licensed mental health professionals.
- [Treatment Centre Directory](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/treatment-rehab): Public listings for rehab and treatment organizations.
- [Support Group Directory](https://www.psychologytoday.com/ca/groups): Public listings for support groups and facilitators.
